stem:
During a school health check-up in Jaipur, Meera's teacher explains how breathing works in the lungs. Which of the following statements about gas exchange in the alveoli is incorrect ( )
A. Fresh air fills the alveoli when we breathe in
B. The thin walls of the alveoli are surrounded by blood vessels
C. Carbon dioxide passes from the alveoli into the blood
D. Oxygen from the air in the alveoli passes into the blood

options.text: Fresh air fills the alveoli when we breathe in
The thin walls of the alveoli are surrounded by blood vessels
Carbon dioxide passes from the alveoli into the blood
Oxygen from the air in the alveoli passes into the blood

teacher.key_rationale: Oxygen moves from alveolar air into the blood, while carbon dioxide moves from the blood into the alveoli to be exhaled. Statement C reverses the direction of carbon dioxide movement, so it is the incorrect statement.
